title: feat(min3split): count 3-site seeds that split f_min from f_L1
science: Exhaustive three-site census with a real structural classification. Over all C(12,3)=220 triples: N_split3=60, N_fill_L1_3=220, N_fill_min_3=160. Two clean statements: f_L1 fills from EVERY three-site seed, and the 60 splits are exactly the 60 seeds on which f_min fails to fill (again no history-only split). Classification of the splits: every split seed meets both end faces (contains a site with x=0 and one with x=2), the 108 seeds missing an end face never split, and every split contains a pair of displacement (2,0,0) or (2,1,1) - 28 long-axis only, 24 opposite-corner only, 8 both. Also tabulates the six observed split history-pair signatures with multiplicities (16/16/8/8/8/4). Extends #6422 from |S|=2 to |S|=3.
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (no (reverse,face) pair stated; pre-verdict campaign phase)
